title: Add ApiScribe to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [ApiScribe](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/apiscribe) to build
- Describe an API in plain English, get organized REST or GraphQL endpoint blueprints with params and responses. BYOP Pollinations-powered.

Fixes #14991

gist.headline: Blueprints from plain English
gist.blurb: ApiScribe joined the garden: describe an API in ordinary words and get a tidy REST or GraphQL blueprint back. The paperwork has learned to photosynthesize.
gist.summary: Added ApiScribe to the app build catalog, giving builders a Pollinations-powered tool that turns plain-English API descriptions into organized REST or GraphQL endpoint blueprints with parameters and responses.
gist.impact: Builders can now discover and use ApiScribe to sketch concrete REST or GraphQL API contracts from an idea before the endpoints become a small forest of implementation details.
gist.visual_concept: Depict ApiScribe as a cozy API blueprint workshop: plain-English notes transform into neatly labeled REST and GraphQL endpoint diagrams on a glowing retro monitor. Polli, wearing tiny architect glasses and holding a pencil, helps arrange the blueprints while code-plants and small flowers grow from the desk, representing an API idea becoming an organized build plan.
